t: Din debarim habbaim betok hasseuda veachar hasseuda umah dinam
s: Din debarim habbaim betok hasseuda veachar hasseuda umah dinam, ubo z' seipim: debarim habbaim betok hasseuda, im hem debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda, dehaynu debarim shedderek liqboa seuda alehem, ben lelappet bahem et happat, kegon basar vedagim viraqot ugebina ubetzim umine meluchim, ben lemazon ulehasbia, kegon kerub uteradin vedaysa vekol maaseh qedera sheenan bain lelappet ella letabshil ulemazon — en tzarik beraka lipnehem, apillu okelam belo pat, shebbirkat "hammotzi" potartam, velo leacharehem, shebbirkat hammazon potartam (shekkevan sheen darkam leekol otam kol hayyom kemo happerot ella bishat seuda bilbad — hare hem tepelim lappat shehu iqqar hasseuda, velaken niptarim bebirkat happat ap al pi sheokelam belo pat). (Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheqqaba seudato al happat, sheaz kol hammaakalim shehem mine liptan velo mine mazon hem) baim mechamat happat, laken hem tepelim eleha. Abal im eno chapetz leekol pat, veokel meat pat umebarek aleha "hammotzi" liptor hammaakalim, yesh lehistappeq im niptarim bebirkatah, kevan sheenan bain mechamatah, o epshar kevan sheddarkam liqboa seuda alehem — happat potartam. Velaken yebarek alehem velo al happat, im lo beshabbat o yom tob):

Veim hem debarim habbaim shello mechamat seuda, dehaynu sheen derek liqboa seuda alehem, lo lelappet velo lehasbia, kegon kol mine perot vekayyotze bahem, ben chayyim ben mebushshalim, vaapillu nitbashshelu im basar, im okel otam belo pat — teunim beraka lipnehem. Vaapillu okelam bigmar hasseuda kede leakkel hammaakal (o leqinnuach lehaqel mikkobed hammaakal) — enan niptarim bebirkat "hammotzi", kevan sheenan meiqqar hasseuda, veen darkam labo mechamat hasseuda leolam, ella darkam leoklam kol hayyom apillu shello bishat seuda. Abal en teunim beraka leacharehem (apillu okelam beemtza hasseuda lo leakkel velo leqinnuach ella letaanug bilbad), shekkevan shebbau betok hasseuda qodem shemmasheku yedehem min happat — birkat hammazon potartam, lepi shekkol mah shebba tok hasseuda hu mikkelal hassebia, shenneemar bah: "vesabota uberakta":

Abal im okelam im pat, naasu tepela lappat, ubirkat "hammotzi" potartan, apillu qaba liptan seudato al dabar acher vehebiu lepanayv perot leqinnuach uletaanug veokel mehem meat im pat. Veim hebium lepanayv lelappet bahem gam ken et happat veakal mehem meat im happat, apillu okel achar kak belo pat — en tzarik lebarek lipnehem im dato leekol od mehem im pat, shekkevan shettechillat akilat happerot vesopah hi im happat — mitztorpin hem im shear hasseuda lehippater bebirkat happat ap mah sheokel benetayim belo pat, kevan shehebiu otam mittechilla lelappet bahem happat, umelappet bahem pat battechilla, vegam bassop dato lelappet bahem. Veap im achar kak nimlak shello lelappet bahem bassop — en bekak kelum, kevan shebbeshaa sheokel mehem al semak birkat "hammotzi" — kavvanato lelappet bahem adayin achar kak. Abal im mittechilla lo hebium lelappet bahem et happat ella leqinnuach seuda, ap shemmelappet bahem pat techilla vasop veokel benetayim belo pat — tzarik lebarek lipnehem, kevan sheiqqaram leqinnuach velo lelappet — enan mitztorpin lishar hasseuda liptor mah sheokel belo pat. Vekol zeh keshettechillat akilato mehapperot hi im pat, abal im matchil leekol belo pat, ap im bau lelappet umelappet bahem ella sheokel meat battechilla belo pat — tzarik lebarek. Vetob linhog ken leolam, keshebbaim lo perot beemtza seudato lelappet happat — leekol mehem techilla meat belo pat ulebarek, veachar kak yokal ben im pat ben belo pat, lepi sheyyesh mistappeqin ap im melappet bahem happat techilla vasop veokel benetayim belo pat — im niptarim bebirkat "hammotzi":

Vekol zeh kesheqqaba liptan seudato al dabar acher ubeemtza hasseuda hebiu lo perot, abal im qaba liptan seudato al happerot — naasu lo happerot kaddebarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda, shenniptarim bebirkat "hammotzi" apillu okelam belo pat bitchillat akilatam, veen tzarik leekol mehem techilla im pat. Veyesh choleqim. Velaken tob sheyyokal techilla meat im pat, veaz ap im achar kak okel mehem belo pat — en tzarik lebarek alehem, vaapillu en dato leekol od im pat, kevan sheiqqar qebiat seudato haya alehem lelappet bahem et happat. Umi sheokel temarim vekayyotze bahem ben maakal lemaakal lehamshik taavat haakila, kevan shehu tzorek seuda — niptarim bebirkat happat bekol inyan, kemo parperaot shennitbaer besiman qa"v:

Vekol maqom sheen happerot niptarim bebirkat happat — tzarik lebarek alehem, apillu hayu lepanayv beshaa shebberak "hammotzi" venitkavven lepoteram. Vekol maqom shehem niptarim — niptarim apillu lo hayu lepanayv beshaa shebberak "hammotzi" velo haya dato alehem (veap al pi shebbekol maqom en haiqqar poter et hattapel bebirkato im en hattapel lepanayv veen dato alayv, mikkol maqom, basseuda kevan sheqqobea atzmo laakila, hare dato min hassetam al kol mah sheyyabiu lepanayv, ap al pi shello haya ken bedato) beperush. Abal im yadua shello haya dato al zeh kelal, kegon sheachar shebberak al happat shalechu lo doron mibbet acherim sheeno samuk alehem velo haya dato al haddoron — eno niptar bebirkat happat apillu hu dabar sheddarko labo lelappet et happat umelappet bo et happat. Veakshav en haolam nizharim bazeh bimdinot ellu, mippene shebbenenu hu dabar matzuy sheechad sholeach lachabero doron basseuda apillu mibbet acherim. (Vekol zeh leinyan im niptar bebirkat happat, abal kol dabar shenniptar bebirkat happat, ap al pi shessiyyem leoklo vegamar belibbo shello leekol mimmennu od bisuda zo vechazar venimlak leekol — en tzarik lebarek alayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"t):

Udebarim habbaim leachar hasseuda (shehaya minhag bimot chakme hattalmud, shebbesop hasseuda hayu moshekim yedehem min happat umesirim otah, vegam hashshulchanot haqqetannim shellipne kol echad veechad, veqobein atzman leekol perot uparperaot leqinnuach seuda velishtot yayin), hare kol mah shemmebiim az lipnehem, apillu debarim sheddarkam labo lelappet happat — teunim beraka ben lipnehem ben leacharehem (veen tzarik lomar perot, chutz mittemarim shenniptarim bebirkat hammazon, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch), mippene she"hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon enan poterim ella mah shenneekal tok iqqar hasseuda, beod shello sillequ yedehem mehappat. Veakshav sheen mesalleqin hashshulchan achar hasseuda qodem birkat hammazon — en lanu silluq happat bistam ad birkat hammazon, o mayim acharonim, o sheyyittol kos birkat hammazon beyado ap al pi shello natal yadayv, o sheyyomar "tenu kos unebarek birkat hammazon, sheaz silleq dato milleekol legamre (veen tzarik lomar im amar beperush shemmesalleq et atzmo milleekol od, ap al pi shello amar "tenu unebarek". Vehu haddin im gamar ken belibbo). Veap al pi sheim chozer venimlak leekol pat yesh mattirin leekol belo beraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"t, veaz yakol gam ken leekol kol haddebarim shennipteru bebirkatah, mikkol maqom, kol zeman shello chazar veyadayv mesullaqot hemenna — en shear debarim niptarim bebirkatah ap al pi shello silleq dato mehem:

Ubisudot gedolot, shergilim limshok yedehem min happat velaarok hashshulchan beperot veliqboa shetiyya — haya rauy lebarek al hammashqim ap al pi shehem baim mechamat hasseuda, vegam beraka acharona al happerot qodem birkat hammazon, ella shello nahagu ken. Veyesh mi shellimmed alehem zekut lomar, shello hitzriku lebarek bimehem ella mishshum shennireh kisuda acheret mah sheokelim veshotim achar silluq hashshulchan, lekak enan niptarim bebirkat happat, lo mibberaka rishona velo mibberaka acharona, abal kol mah sheokelin veshotin al hashshulchan sheakelu alayv happat — seuda achat hi im happat, velaken niptarim bebirkoteha, ap al pi shessillequ datam mimmenna legamre, vaapillu ameru "tenu unebarek", ad sheyyittelu mayim acharonim, o sheyyittol kos birkat hammazon, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"t:
